preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract deployer/owner
Contract must not have been initialized yet (fresh deployment)

exploit_hint: The contract uses a constructor instead of an initializer function, making it vulnerable to front-running attacks. As the deployer, call the constructor with malicious parameters (e.g., set token address to attacker-controlled token, set subsequentClaim to 100e18 for instant 100% claims). This allows unauthorized initialization of critical contract parameters.
